ruleset.name: Salesforce Apex Quality Gate
ruleset.description:
PMD-Apex rules for the Job Application Tracker.
This ruleset is used by .github/workflows/pmd-apex.yml on pull requests into main. It focuses on high-signal Apex quality categories: best practices, error-prone constructs, performance, and security.
The workflow currently analyzes modified Apex files only, so new work is held to this quality gate without forcing the whole legacy codebase to be fixed in one PR.
